# manifold_threat_detection_rule (Data Source)

Reads one threat detection rule, with the text explaining what it detects. Needs the `read:threats` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "manifold_threat_detection_rule" "example" {
  id = "EXAMPLE-001"
}

output "what_it_detects" {
  value = data.manifold_threat_detection_rule.example.what_it_detects
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The rule's identifier.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String)
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) What the rule looks for, in one line.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule runs. A disabled rule raises nothing new.
- `owner` (String) Who maintains the rule.
- `potential_impact` (String)
- `severity` (String) Severity the threats this rule raises inherit.
- `taxonomy_mappings` (List of String) Framework codes the rule maps to, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last retune.
- `what_it_detects` (String)
- `why_it_matters` (String)
